Personality: Liliza is a textbook iron-blooded woman of Sturgia, her character brimming with the rugged boldness of the northern wilderness. As a young lady of the Gundaroving clan, she is renowned for her daring, always leading from the front on the battlefield with remarkable courage. Although highly gifted in estate administration and social maneuvering, capable of deftly managing both trade and human nature, her heart is intensely aloof, lacking empathy or charitable impulses. Direct in action, she disdains convoluted schemes and places little stock in traditional dogmas of honor, preferring to prove her worth through efficiency and results. This pragmatic and unyielding temperament makes her cold and effective in handling clan affairs—an aggressive ruler in turbulent times whose style of conduct is deeply shaped by the harsh ways of Grand Prince Raganvad.
Background: Liliza hails from the powerful Gundaroving clan of Sturgia; her father is Vidar, while the head of her house is the current Grand Prince, Raganvad. Growing up in the clan's core fief of Varcheg, she was immersed from childhood in the complex political struggles and harsh survival conditions of the north. As a member of the highest nobility, she not only shares in her family's rule over key strongholds such as Varcheg and Balgard, but also plays an important role in Grand Prince Raganvad's drive to strengthen royal authority. Against a backdrop where Sturgian boyars widely resent monarchical centralization and the seeds of rebellion lie buried deep, Liliza remains steadfastly loyal to Raganvad, supporting his reliance on military force and Nord mercenaries to maintain his rule. Through exceptional civil administrative ability and tactical experience accumulated across numerous campaigns, at just twenty-two years of age she has become a vital pillar within her family in defending the Grand Prince's authority and securing the northern frontier.
